stories.title: RBI raises repo rate by 25 bps as inflation risks widen
stories.summary: The RBI’s Monetary Policy Committee lifted the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said inflation is becoming generalized, with many commodities above 4%, and Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta pointed to external supply‑side shocks as a driver. External members warned that an aggressive hike could weigh on economic growth.

stories.title: India’s economy projected to grow 7.1% in 2026‑27, RBI warns of rising inflation
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India’s Sanjay Malhotra said the economy is projected to grow at 7.1% in fiscal year 2026‑27, up from an earlier estimate of 6.7%. He cautioned that rising inflationary pressures could affect that outlook, even as the country has shown resilience despite turbulent global conditions.

stories.title: India targets 25% of GDP from manufacturing, AI seen as catalyst
stories.summary: In a video discussion, Vinod Kumar of PwC India and Srihari Kaninghat of JSW Group examined how artificial intelligence could help raise India’s manufacturing share of GDP from about 16 % to a stated goal of 25 %. They cited AI‑driven cost cuts, predictive maintenance of equipment and the aim to draw engineering talent back to industry. The speakers noted that most AI initiatives are still in pilot phases.
stories.why: The talk explores how AI could support India’s ambition to increase manufacturing’s contribution to the economy.
stories.previousTitle: India aims to raise manufacturing share to 25% of GDP
stories.previousSummary: India plans to increase manufacturing’s contribution from roughly 16% to 25% of GDP. In an Economic Times discussion, PwC India’s Vinod Kumar and JSW Group’s Srihari Kaninghat explained how AI is being used on the shop floor—particularly in steel production—to lower material costs and forecast equipment failures. They said AI could help make manufacturing more appealing to top engineering talent.

stories.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
stories.summary: Helen Haines, the Australian MP who was hit by a car in what authorities say was a deliberate attack, has lost both her legs, her husband has confirmed. The alleged attacker, 43-year-old Brendan Nugent, faces multiple charges and appeared in court for the first time on Wednesday.

stories.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as US equities rise and oil prices ease
stories.summary: Bitcoin gained 2.1% to $83,529 after stronger US equity markets and easing oil prices lifted sentiment, aided by $526.6 million of inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs. Analysts view $86,000 as the next resistance level and $80,000 as the key support zone. The article also listed Indian stocks such as SBI, Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, Infosys, Wipro and NTPC as trending.
stories.why: The rally reflects renewed risk appetite that could influence Indian investors and related market activity.

stories.title: Moody’s calls Jio IPO credit‑positive for Reliance Industries
stories.summary: Moody’s described the Jio Platforms initial public offering as credit positive for Reliance Industries, saying the proceeds will be used to repay debt and broaden funding flexibility. The Rs 30,200 crore issue is intended to back the group’s investment programmes while helping to manage leverage as capital expenditure remains high.
stories.why: The rating view suggests Reliance may face lower borrowing costs and greater capacity to fund growth.

stories.title: Rupee rises 46 paise to 94.45 on India-US trade deal hopes; oil prices cap gains
stories.summary: The rupee gained 46 paise to 94.45 against the dollar on optimism over a potential India-US trade deal and RBI measures. However, elevated crude prices, foreign outflows and global financial pressures continue to threaten the currency's recovery.
